title: Portfolio State Updated Event
description: Schema for EVT:PORTFOLIO_STATE_UPDATED event payload describing complete portfolio state

ts.description: Timestamp of portfolio state snapshot in milliseconds

equity.description: Current equity/capital value in USD (string-encoded Decimal for precision)

realized_pnl.description: Total realized profit and loss in USD (string-encoded Decimal for precision)

unrealized_pnl.description: Current unrealized profit and loss in USD (string-encoded Decimal for precision)

net_position.description: Net position quantity (positive = long, negative = short) (string-encoded Decimal for precision)

avg_entry_price.description: Average entry price for the position (string-encoded Decimal for precision)

venues.description: List of venues where this position has exposure
